description: TRANUS provides an integrated land-use and transport modelling system for activity location, property markets and passenger and freight transport. The provider is Modelistica. Geographical and temporal coverage: TRANUS supports city and regional scenarios with Spanish documentation. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): Creative Commons (version not stated on the page read). The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The provider states free, open-source software under Creative Commons but does not identify the licence variant on the homepage. Current execution and maintenance were not checked. For simulation, the documented contents can support coupled land-use and multimodal transport scenarios. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
